title: Bug: Inventory.restock() crashes with KeyError when adding a new item to stock
body:
## Bug Report
**File:** `src/inventory_manager.py`

The `restock(name, qty)` method raises `KeyError` when the item is not already in stock (it should add new items automatically). Additionally `get_low_stock(threshold)` returns items whose stock is strictly greater than the threshold instead of at-or-below, so critically low stock is never reported.
### Expected
- `restock('NewItem', 5)` adds the item instead of crashing
- `get_low_stock(10)` includes items with stock == 10
